items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: Maureen was a singer that, when I was a little girl... Maureen and Paureen, that's her husband. They used to come there with a carnival... Maureen would sing... I remember that.

ctx.x: Around Columbus, too. Yeah, and she was with me for years. Which was your favorite blues singer? Who did you like best, their voice and all?
Well, I worked with either London than I did anybody else, so I guess I would probably have to say that. But Maureen was a singer that, when I was a little girl...
I like that deep quality that she had, that big, heavy voice. Maureen?
